run_teleop_marker_server: run the TeleopMarkerServer to start interactive ROS marker controls for teleoperating a Stretch robot
create_base_marker: create an interactive base marker widget for controlling robot base motion in the X-Y plane and Z rotation
create_arm_marker: create an interactive arm marker widget for controlling the robot arm position along Y and Z axes
create_gripper_marker: create an interactive gripper marker widget for controlling wrist roll, pitch, and yaw rotations
stow_robot_arm: stow the robot arm by setting the arm joint to zero and moving to the home configuration
